name: Vitamins & Supplements
description: Governed package and normalized-unit comparison of vitamins and dietary supplements, including evidence-backed label certifications.

include: oral vitamins, minerals, amino acids, botanicals, and dietary supplements

human_review_conditions: active ingredient or strength conflicts across evidence sources
certification is visible only in an image

required_caveats: Spring Valley is the Walmart anchor portfolio; brand equality is not expected across retailers.
USP, NSF, MSC, or other certifications are reported only when supported by PDP text or label-image evidence.
Rollback is reported only when Walmart supplies explicit Rollback evidence; a regular-versus-current price difference alone is a generic markdown.

narrative_playbook.leadership_objective: Show where Spring Valley leads or trails equivalent vitamin and supplement specifications on package and normalized-unit price, with auditable label evidence.

decision_lenses.label: Exact specification
decision_lenses.question: Where does Spring Valley lead products with the same ingredient, strength, form, and package?

decision_lenses.label: Compatible unit value
decision_lenses.question: Where does normalized unit price change the competitive position?

decision_lenses.label: Certification evidence
decision_lenses.question: Which products have verified USP, NSF, MSC, or other label certification evidence?

action_principles: Keep exact specification and compatible specification conclusions separate.
Use package and normalized-unit price together before interpreting value.
Route missing or conflicting label evidence to review rather than inference.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim a certification without PDP text or label-image evidence.
Do not call a markdown a Walmart Rollback without explicit Rollback evidence.
Do not treat brand equality as a match requirement for Spring Valley substitutes.

insight_rules.summary_template: {competitor} is lower more often than {benchmark} for the selected governed vitamin specification.
insight_rules.business_impact: Review package and normalized-unit price before prioritizing a response.

insight_rules.summary_template: {benchmark} is lower across most validated comparisons in this specification.
insight_rules.business_impact: Protect the value position and monitor evidence freshness.
